problem.description: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (Not Found) for 127.0.0.1:8000/api/convert
error_messages: AxiosError: Request failed with status code 404

hypotheses.description: Backend endpoint /api/convert is missing or misspelled

findings: There are multiple processes listening on port 8000.
The project's backend is running on 0.0.0.0:8000 (PID 101948)
Another unknown application is running on 127.0.0.1:8000 (PID 108172)
Because 127.0.0.1 is more specific than 0.0.0.0, the unknown application intercepts all requests to 127.0.0.1:8000.
The unknown application does not have the /api/convert endpoint, which causes the 404 error.

resolution.root_cause: Port conflict on 8000. Another application bound specifically to 127.0.0.1:8000 is intercepting requests intended for the project backend bound to 0.0.0.0:8000.
resolution.fix_applied: Change the backend and frontend port from 8000 to 8088 to avoid conflicts.
resolution.verification: Check if port 8088 is free and the backend starts properly on it.
